card.name: Tolerance and withdrawal wording in dependence text
card.fires_on: The word "tolerance" in opioid and dependence passages, and the middle of words like "Pro-tracted" (withdrawal), "ab-stinence" and "contr-actions". It appears mainly in drug dependence and withdrawal sections.

modes.label: Tolerance
